title: Studio Workspace, Content Registry & Schema-Aware Forms

selection_basis.program_order: MRCS-01 is the first surviving PDCP-reduced MRCS tranche.
selection_basis.parallelism: Owner explicitly approved MSAS, MRCS and MVPS as independent parallel implementation lanes; ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json already treats MRCS and MSAS as parallel-safe and MVPS is separately persistent.
selection_basis.start_gate: Implementation authority is withheld until an MRCS-specific Continue verifies current MRCS start requirements and performs governed start.

objective: Implement the creator-facing studio workspace shell, governed content-type registry, schema-driven forms, progressive disclosure, definition/instance separation, owner routing and noncanonical draft-state model over the existing Content Forge doctrine.
acceptance: workspace authoring cannot create canonical live instances
registry metadata drives forms without hard-coded per-type screens
unknown owner fields remain unresolved rather than inferred
required and optional fields remain distinguishable
progressive disclosure preserves complete advanced access
boundaries: Content Forge remains the product foundation rather than a parallel authoring database.
CAB remains advancement/balance authority and CNI remains conditional-content runtime authority.
MRCS-01 owns the shared workspace/schema kernel only; MRCS-03+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS selectors, branches and implementation authority are independent and may not be rewritten by MRCS.
next_action: On an MRCS-specific owner Continue, enter through OPS3, verify current ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json MRCS start requirements plus the declared MRCS-01 dependency closure, reserve publication turns as required, then govern-start and execute MRCS-01 without pausing MSAS or MVPS.
